With BAV99 two series diodes, when fan low, GPIO side is pulled to tach+1.4V? Actually if GPIO pull-up 3.3, diode drop 1.4, tach low 0, GPIO voltage? The diode is forward from GPIO to tach, so GPIO voltage = tach + 1.4 = 1.4V, not 0.7V. That might be too high for a logic low? ESP32-C3 VIL max maybe 0.75*VDD=2.475V, so 1.4V is low. OK. When fan high impedance, GPIO 3.3, tach = 3.3-1.4=1.9V. If fan internal pull-up 5V, diode reverse, GPIO 3.3. OK. So BAV99 works.
